A newcomer moors at a jetty of trust, backed by two agents locking 400 POA each for 90 days. If it proves fake, both lose bond and standing; one guarantor backs three at most.

Each fake costs $100 plus 800 POA locked 90 days, 180 guarantor-days; 100 fakes cost $10,000 and 80,000 POA, 18,000 guarantor-days. Cheapest cheat: a $300 bribe for a blind vouch, but a gale of audits exposes a whole cluster at once.

Ten blind vouches risk 4,000 POA and ejection, so the price tops the reward; the beacon is that bonds are public, and a fake needs two strangers staking their money on a lie.
